name: normalized
why: signed_zero: equal in the exact reading, differs at -0
parent: export function f(x: number): number { return x; }
candidate: export function f(x: number): number { return x === 0 ? 0 : x; }

name: magnitude
parent: export function f(x: number): number { return x < 0 ? -x : x; }
candidate: export function f(x: number): number { return Math.abs(x); }

name: plus_zero
parent: export function f(x: number): number { return x + 0; }
candidate: export function f(x: number): number { return x; }

name: positive
why: signed_zero: equal in the integer reading, differs at 0.5 (integrality)
parent: export function f(n: number): number { return n > 0 ? n : 1; }
candidate: export function f(n: number): number { return n >= 1 ? n : 1; }

name: flipped
parent: export function f(n: number): number { return n > 0 ? -n : 1; }
candidate: export function f(n: number): number { return n >= 1 ? 0 - n : 1; }

name: clamp
parent: export function f(x: number): number { return Math.min(Math.max(x, 0), 100); }
candidate: export function f(x: number): number { return x > 0 ? (x < 100 ? x : 100) : 0; }

name: big_int
parent: export function f(x: number): number { return x + 1 - 1; }
candidate: export function f(x: number): number { return x; }

name: count_exact
why: a counter over a length, exact in the safe range
parent: export function f(xs: string[]): number { let n = 0; for (const x of xs) { if (x.length > 2) n++; } return n * 2 + xs.length; }
candidate: export function f(xs: string[]): number { let n = 0; for (const x of xs) { if (x.length > 2) n += 1; } return xs.length + 2 * n; }

name: same_ops_congruence
why: the same double operations on the same values, the surrounding code refactored
parent: export function f(x: number, y: number): number { const s = x + y; if (s > 10) { return s * 2; } return s; }
candidate: export function f(x: number, y: number): number { const s = x + y; return s > 10 ? s * 2 : s; }

name: pinned_literal
why: an equality with a nonzero integer literal is faithful
parent: export function f(x: number): string { return x === 5 ? "five" : "other"; }
candidate: export function f(x: number): string { if (x === 5) return "five"; return "other"; }

name: zero_unpinned
why: an equality with 0 is not pinned (-0): congruence only
parent: export function f(x: number): number { return x === 0 ? 0 : x; }
candidate: export function f(x: number): number { return x === 0 ? x : x; }
